name: Pagination
description: Page numbers with previous and next buttons, folding long runs into an ellipsis.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the page that was chosen.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown either side of the current one.

props.name: boundaries
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and the end.

props.name: variant
props.description: Compact shows "Page 3 of 20" between the arrows instead of page numbers.

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string; next?: string; page?: (page: number) => string }
props.description: Accessible names for the arrows and page buttons, for translation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of a nav.
